sources.title: Shaoguan municipal construction review of the city’s data center projects
sources.attribution: Shaoguan Daily, Li Fangjing and Jiang Linlei; republished by Shaoguan Municipal People’s Government.
sources.summary: At its November 24 progress review, Shaoguan’s municipal leadership identified the China Mobile Phase 2 and China Telecom Shaotang projects as under construction. The city distinguished the separately planned China Mobile Shaotang project.

firsthand_status_statement.speaker: Shaoguan municipal project coordination meeting chaired by municipal committee secretary Chen Jinluan and attended by Mayor Wu Qinghua
firsthand_status_statement.speaker_role: Municipal project oversight and coordination authority. The committee reviewed the cluster, and the chair and officials visited construction sites to supervise progress and resolve project issues. The attribution is to the meeting collectively.
firsthand_status_statement.project_identity: China Mobile Greater Bay Area (Shaoguan) Data Center Phase 2, and the China Telecom Shaotang campus development, both in Shaoguan.
firsthand_status_statement.statement: The meeting’s own progress assessment placed the two named projects among sites under construction and set commissioning as a future objective. It separately described China Mobile Shaotang as being at a preparatory stage.
firsthand_status_statement.date_semantics: The report expressly dates the municipal review November 24, one day before publication. This is a construction observation, not a groundbreaking date.
firsthand_status_statement.review: The explicit list of projects whose construction is ongoing carries the status. A site visit on its own, scheduling of commissioning and earlier tenders do not determine the stage.

extraction.other_mobile_project: China Mobile Shaotang is described separately as being in preparation.
extraction.scope: Campus or phase-level construction, without assigning work packages, live IT load or a narrower physical stage.
